# Unit-test harness generated by the ut tool (CppUTest/GoogleTest). Add new test files to UT_SOURCES.
cmake_minimum_required(VERSION 3.16)
find_library(CPPUTEST_LIB CppUTest REQUIRED)
find_library(CPPUTEST_EXT CppUTestExt REQUIRED)

find_package(Threads REQUIRED)
set(UT_SOURCES
  ${CMAKE_CURRENT_SOURCE_DIR}/smoke_test.cpp
  ${CMAKE_CURRENT_SOURCE_DIR}/cvclient_test.cpp
  ${CMAKE_CURRENT_SOURCE_DIR}/dispatcher_test.cpp
  ${CMAKE_CURRENT_SOURCE_DIR}/memory_pool_test.cpp
  ${CMAKE_CURRENT_SOURCE_DIR}/perf_monitor_test.cpp
  ${CMAKE_CURRENT_SOURCE_DIR}/request_queue_test.cpp
  ${CMAKE_CURRENT_SOURCE_DIR}/service_test.cpp
  ${CMAKE_CURRENT_SOURCE_DIR}/session_manager_test.cpp
  ${CMAKE_CURRENT_SOURCE_DIR}/main.cpp
)
set(UT_CODE_UNDER_TEST
  ${CMAKE_SOURCE_DIR}/client/src/cvclient.cpp
  ${CMAKE_SOURCE_DIR}/src/dispatcher.cpp
  ${CMAKE_SOURCE_DIR}/src/memory_pool.cpp
  ${CMAKE_SOURCE_DIR}/src/perf_monitor.cpp
  ${CMAKE_SOURCE_DIR}/src/request_queue.cpp
  ${CMAKE_SOURCE_DIR}/src/service.cpp
  ${CMAKE_SOURCE_DIR}/src/session_manager.cpp
)
add_executable(unit_tests ${UT_SOURCES} ${UT_CODE_UNDER_TEST})
target_include_directories(unit_tests PRIVATE ${CMAKE_SOURCE_DIR}/client/include ${CMAKE_SOURCE_DIR}/include ${CMAKE_CURRENT_SOURCE_DIR}/mocks)
target_link_libraries(unit_tests PRIVATE ${CPPUTEST_EXT} ${CPPUTEST_LIB} Threads::Threads)
target_compile_options(unit_tests PRIVATE -Wall -Wextra)
add_test(NAME unit_tests COMMAND unit_tests -v)
